parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupID
parameters.description: The resource group ID. Each resource group has a globally unique resource group ID. You can use the resource group ID to retrieve information about the resource group.

parameters.name: TimeStep
parameters.description:
The time step. Default value: 5m. Valid values for the time unit:

- h: hours.

- m: minutes.

- s: seconds.

If no unit is specified, the default unit s (seconds) is used.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
